headline: test3's Gibbs-White Fielding Fresh Interest
deck: Spurs gossip circles Gibbs-White, owned by test3, with Gabriel and White also in Monday's talk
body:
Monday's gossip lands on three names already on rolls in this league. Gibbs-White, test3's man, sits at the centre of a reported Spurs move worth a figure that would make anyone's ownership feel provisional. Nothing is settled, and until it is, test3 keeps him.

Around the same column, test31121's Gabriel has his next step unresolved and test3331 owns White. The wire offers no dates, no fees confirmed, no line-ups. What is known is that three managers here are watching the same speculation the rest of us are, and holding their assets until it hardens into fact.
